annotations.title: A saved person's kundli at a glance

description: Summary of one saved person's birth chart: their nature (Lagna, Moon sign, nakshatra), the life chapter and phase they are in now with dates (Mahadasha / Antardasha), their most notable yoga and how rare it is, and which life areas are strong or need care, with what helps. Use when the user asks about themselves or a saved family member: personality, a child's nature, strengths, what to work on, why life feels a certain way. Same shape as free_kundli, read from the saved chart. Read-only. Only for people saved on the user's AstroCalc account (needs a free AstroCalc sign-in); birth details typed in the chat work without sign-in in free_kundli, kundli_milan, explain_dasha, full_chart and life_timeline.

lang.description: Language of the text fields: 'en' (English, default) or 'hi' (Hindi).

profile.description: A saved kundli on the user's AstroCalc account: its name as listed by my_profiles (e.g. 'Mummy') or its id.
